name: EPIC 212341734

text.card: A red giant 4,655 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,008 K at its surface.
